intro.text: A perpendicularity on Roshar that Dalinar summoned at Thaylen City, a column of golden light linking the realms.

description.text: While open, it lets people cross between Shadesmar and the Physical Realm and gives near-unlimited Stormlight, refilling gemstones and letting Surgebinders use their full power. In Shadesmar, it appears as a column of light that melts the beads into solid ground.

items.text: During the battle at Thaylen City, after swearing his Third Ideal as a Bondsmith, Dalinar summoned the perpendicularity. Odium withdrew almost as soon as he saw it, and it closed after a few moments.
While it was open, Taln seemed aware of his surroundings, and Dalinar understood things he had never been taught. In Shadesmar, the Fused were blasted away by it.
Cusicesh opened Honor's Perpendicularity for the Iriali to leave Roshar on the next stage of the Long Trail.
